author: Samsung
description:
Korean treasures beholding 2,000 years of endless inspiration. Feel the connection expanding across time and borders, at the Art Institute of Chicago's 'Korean National Treasures' exhibition from March 7th to July 5th 🏛️✨. Collected and cherished by the late Samsung Chairman Lee Kun-Hee, the collection can also be explored through Samsung Art Store 🎨.

#KInspiration #KCulture #KoreanNationalTreasures #NationalMuseumofKorea #ArtInstituteofChicago #Samsung
